g.text: D - Explicit LRZ cluster round trip

text.tspan: Routing guardrail: the generic and FGFR2 branches share infrastructure and audit contracts but remain distinct scientific workflows.
The coordinate evidence register is additive: it copies existing scientific values and provenance; it does not recompute biological results.
